paragraphs: WhatsApp CRM for Indian businesses, built on the official WhatsApp Business API (Meta Cloud API). A shared team inbox, contacts, pipelines, broadcasts, no-code automations and flows, an AI chatbot, a product catalog, reports, journeys (drip and win-back messages), Shopify, WooCommerce, Calendly, Cal.com, Shiprocket and Razorpay integrations, inbound webhooks, plans with a free trial, and a public REST API.

Website: repeatgrow.com · App: repeatgrow.com/login · Help Center: repeatgrow.com/docs · API reference: repeatgrow.com/docs/api · Support: support@repeatgrow.com · LinkedIn: repeat-grow · Reviews: Trustpilot

Status: feature freeze. The product is feature-complete for launch. No new features will be built until there are customers; the focus is testing on the live site, fixing bugs and onboarding. Ideas are parked in TODO.md.
